description: The file 'fix.patch' must exist and be a valid unified diff format.
After applying the patch, the previously failing unit test must pass.
The patch must not modify the assertion logic in the failing test file.
check: git diff fix.patch -- <failing_test_file> | grep -E 'expect|assert|should' | grep -v 'expect.*toBe|assert.*equal' || true

description: Applying the patch must not introduce new failing tests in the suite.
